rule: `macro`: a macro invocation (C/C++/ObjC function-like macros, Rust `name!`). Calls written inside macro arguments are separate ordinary edges. | Macro invocations → call_type macro; calls inside macro arguments are ordinary edges.
notes: Layout: src/ (the scan root) holds a Cargo package, Cargo.toml plus src/*.rs, so module paths are crate-relative. Macro ID = the macro's name without `!` (the `!` is invocation syntax; macro_rules! defines `square`). square is defined in the scan → high (cf. C: high if #defined in the scan); std macros are named statically but not defined in the scan → medium (cf. gtest macros: macro, medium). Calls written inside macro arguments, including a macro inside a macro, are separate edges on their own lines. The macro_rules! definition is a declaration.
